analysis.reason: RSI 36.3에서 44.3으로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 또한 -6.3017에서 0.4122로 개선되며 바닥 다지기 신호. 5일 연속 음봉 마감 후 반등 시도 구간 진입.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-6.3017→0.4122): 개선 구간, 약세 수렴 종료 및 강세 전환 신호

[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 ($414.50): SMA20($408.68) 및 볼린저 상단($450.70) 저항 구간

[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): RSI 및 MACD 개선으로 매수 고려 가능하나 거래량 부재로 관망 유지 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($395.10) vs SMA5($399.81)/SMA20($408.68)/SMA50($429.88): Short-term resistance zone, below mid-term
· Position vs SMA100($424.64)/SMA200($401.65): Below mid-long term trend, potential bearish shift with EMA200 above
· 52-week Position (58.1%) + Historically mid-range price level
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (36.3→44.3): Exiting oversold territory, confirming upward momentum
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-6.3017→0.4122): Improving trend, signaling end of bearish convergence and potential bullish shift
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-Band $408.68): Trading near the mid-band, exploring direction
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($386.02): Support zone based on Pivot S1($350.57) and EMA200($393.67)
· Swing Resistance ($414.50): Resistance zone near SMA20($408.68) and Bollinger Upper Band($450.70)
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low recovery initiation): Suggesting potential shift from bearish trend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.41x): Subdued volume, reducing bounce conviction
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone): Buy consideration due to RSI and MACD improvement, but maintaining wait-and-see due to lack of volume.
